objects.name: Detection technique coverage: rubeus-kerberos-ticket-exports-through-winlogon-access
objects.description: The following analytic detects a process accessing the winlogon.exe system process, indicative of the Rubeus tool attempting to export Kerberos tickets from memory. This detection leverages Sysmon EventCode 10 logs, focusing on processes obtaining a handle to winlogon.exe with specific access rights.
